steps: Модель: X would like to buy … for …

6-s87.condition: Unit 6, Section 1, упр. 6, с. 87. Составь в паре диалог в магазине одежды: 1) Тайни покупает одежду для дня рождения; 2) Тайни покупает одежду для пикника.
steps: Опорные фразы: Can I help you? — I would like to buy… — What colour? — Here you are! — How much is it / are they? — … pounds.

1. — Hello! Can I help you? — I would like to buy a dress and shoes for my birthday party. — What colour? — Pink, please. — Here you are! — How much are they? — 30 pounds. — Here you are. Thank you. Goodbye.
2. — Hello! Can I try on a hat and a T-shirt, please? — What colour? — Green and yellow, please. — Here you are! — How much are they? — 50 pounds. — Here you are. Thank you. Goodbye.
6-s87.answer: Пример: — Can I help you? — I'd like to buy a dress and shoes for my birthday party. — What colour? — Pink, please. — Here you are! — How much are they? — 30 pounds. — Thank you. Goodbye.

steps: Порядок прилагательных: new + размер/длина + цвет + существительное.

Yesterday Miss Chatter bought a new short blouse and new long trousers.
Yesterday Miss Chatter bought a new black dress and new blue mittens.

steps: 1. Can you show me the trousers, please? — Here you are. — How much are they? — Ten pounds.
2. Can I help you? — Show me the jacket, please. — Here you are.

9-s88.condition: Unit 6, Section 1, упр. 9, с. 88. Разыграй диалоги из упр. 8 с одноклассником.
steps: 1. Tim: Excuse me, can you show me the trousers? — Shop assistant: Yes, here you are. — Tim: How much are they? — Ten pounds. — Tim: Here you are. — Thank you.
2. Shop assistant: Can I help you? — Tim: Show me the jacket, please. — Here you are. — Tim: Great! It's nice and warm! — Anything else? — Tim: No, thank you. That's all.
9-s88.answer: Диалоги разыгрываем по ролям: покупатель просит показать вещь (Can you show me…?), спрашивает цену (How much is it?), продавец отвечает (Here you are. Ten pounds. Anything else?).

12-s89.answer: a little Baby Elephant; was sad; socks, a T-shirt and shorts; Mrs Lion's shop; beautiful yellow socks; his new socks

13-s89.condition: Unit 6, Section 1, упр. 13, с. 89. a) Прочитай и разыграй диалог папы Слона и Слонёнка. b) Прочитай и разыграй диалог папы Слона и миссис Львицы.
steps: a) Father Elephant: Why are you sad, my little Baby Elephant? — Baby Elephant: Oh dad, I want to play in our school football team. But my socks, T-shirt and shorts are too small and I can't wear them. — Father Elephant: Don't worry, my dear! I will buy you nice new clothes.

b) Father Elephant: Good morning, Mrs Lion. — Mrs Lion: Good morning, Mr Elephant! Can I help you? — Father Elephant: Have you got any nice socks for my Baby Elephant? — Mrs Lion: All our socks are too small for your Baby Elephant. But wait a little, and my little Lions will make him new beautiful socks.
13-s89.answer: a) Слонёнок грустит: одежда мала для футбольной команды; папа обещает купить новую. b) У миссис Львицы носки малы, но львята сделают новые. Читаем по ролям.

14-s89.condition: Unit 6, Section 1, упр. 14, с. 89. Ответь на вопросы по сказке о Слонёнке.

2. They went to Mrs Lion's shop because they wanted to buy new socks.
3. The little Lions made new socks because all the socks in the shop were too small.
4. Baby Elephant was very glad because he liked his new socks.
5. They went to Mrs Tiger's shop because they wanted to buy a new T-shirt and shorts.
14-s89.answer: 1. His clothes were too small. 2. To buy new socks. 3. All the socks in the shop were too small. 4. He liked his new socks. 5. To buy a T-shirt and shorts.

steps: Модель: There is … in Jim's classroom. But there is no … in our classroom.
There is a video in Jim's classroom, but there is no video in our classroom.
There is a goldfish in Jim's classroom, but there is no goldfish in our classroom.
There is a computer in our classroom, but there is no computer in Jim's classroom.

3-s101.condition: Unit 7, Section 1, упр. 3, с. 101. Прочитай новые слова и расскажи, чем ты обычно занимаешься на уроке.
steps: Новые слова: read, count, write, speak, ask, answer, translate, learn by heart.
We usually read, count, write, speak English, ask and answer questions and translate from Russian into English in the lesson.
3-s101.answer: In the lesson we usually read, count, write, speak, ask and answer questions and translate from Russian into English.

4-s101.condition: Unit 7, Section 1, упр. 4, с. 101. a) и b) Соотнеси слова, получи выражения и составь с ними предложения.
steps: a) speak English, learn by heart, sing songs, answer questions: We always speak English in class. I don't like to learn poems by heart. Masha sings songs every day. When the teacher asks you a question, you must answer it.

b) stand up, translate from … into …, count from 1 to 100, sit down: Pupils stand up when the teacher comes. We often translate from Russian into English. I can count from 1 to 100 in English. We sit down when the lesson starts.
4-s101.answer: a) speak English, learn by heart, sing songs, answer questions. b) stand up, translate from Russian into English, count from 1 to 100, sit down. Предложения — в решении.

5-s101.condition: Unit 7, Section 1, упр. 5, с. 101. Расскажи, чем ты обычно занимаешься на уроке и во время перемены.
steps: In the lesson we usually read, count, write, speak, ask and answer questions and translate.
During the break we usually talk and play games.
5-s101.answer: In the lesson we read, write, count, speak and answer questions. During the break we talk and play games.

6-s101.condition: Unit 7, Section 1, упр. 6, с. 101. Расскажи, что ученики должны и не должны делать в классе, используя данные выражения.
steps: must — должны, mustn't — нельзя.
Pupils must answer the teacher's questions, say "Good morning!" to the teacher and be polite to their classmates.
Pupils mustn't take a pet to the lesson, speak loudly, sleep in the classroom, draw on the desks and walls, write notes to friends, run and jump between the desks.
6-s101.answer: Must: answer the teacher's questions, greet the teacher, be polite. Mustn't: bring pets, speak loudly, sleep, draw on desks and walls, write notes, run between the desks.

13-s103.condition: Unit 7, Section 1, упр. 13, с. 103. Расскажи, что вчера делали Джейсон и Бекки в школе.
steps: Jason and Becky had three lessons. The first lesson was Maths: they counted pencils and played computer games.
In the second lesson they learned English: they spoke English and wrote new words.
In the third lesson they sang songs and drew funny pictures. The children had a good time at school.

14-s103.condition: Unit 7, Section 1, упр. 14, с. 103. Спроси одноклассников, что им нравится и не нравится делать на уроках английского, и заполни таблицу.

steps: My classmates like to read in the English lesson. Sasha and Masha like to speak English. Nobody likes to sing.

16-s103.condition: Unit 7, Section 1, упр. 16, с. 103. Скажи, что вы обычно делаете на уроках английского языка.
steps: In the English lesson we usually read texts and translate them. We read poems and learn them by heart. We speak English and play games. We sing English songs. We ask and answer questions.
16-s103.answer: In the English lesson we read and translate texts, learn poems by heart, speak English, play games, sing songs, ask and answer questions.
